t: Alt Home: Innovation, Design and Style: Modern Marvels
d: Jillian tours three boundary-pushing homes with a modern twist: the iconic Garduno Heiser treehouse, Los Angeles' first 3D-printed, low-carbon micro-living home and a vibrant modern masterpiece that redefines what it means to live artfully.

t: Serving Up Style: The Thanksgiving Table & More
d: Easy how-tos for hosting a memorable gathering.

t: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
d: DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home  Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

t: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
d: Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall  when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

t: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
d: Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views  when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

t: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
d: Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat  she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

Levi heads to Issaquah at Ananda, a modern sanctuary featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking the Raging River  next, he travels to Ashford to visit Treehouse Mt. Rainier, a rustic-elegant escape supported entirely by eight towering trees.

Levi visits two retreats that celebrate open spaces and minimalist design  he starts at the Alto A-Frame, an elevated architectural gem nestled beside a creek  next, he tours the Timber Haus, a Scandinavian-inspired stay tucked in a field of florals.

Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries  first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage  next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.

Levi travels to Ringgold, Georgia, to experience two towering stays  first, he scales the Selah Ridge Watchtower, a 35-foot-tall sanctuary  just a short hike away is the Selah Ridge Treehouse, a B&B that takes the tiny stay concept to new heights.

st: Cleaned Up Kitchen Chaos & Clutter Busted Closet
d: For Charmaine and Cameron's growing family, the kitchen has become the center of chaos  in a few simple steps, Brandie and Ryan edit, decant and transform their kitchen into a haven of organization.
The Home Sort sisters transform spaces from chaos to clutter-free, in this case focusing on bathroom and laundry room revamps.

t: Woodward Throwbacks: Rust, Relics and Relaxation
d: Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design  the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.
